1: # Tasks: retro-educational-game-asset-pipeline-v1
2: 
3: > Six phases. Each phase ends with a validation gate (the box at the
4: > bottom). Mark a task done with `[x]` only after the listed
5: > verification has passed.
6: 
7: ## Phase 0: Stack updates (mechanical, ~half a day)
8: 
9: The two existing stacks point at the wrong upstream images; the eight
10: new stacks are all 6-file GOLD_STANDARD follows of
11: `bonneagar/stacks/invokeai/compose.yaml` plus their own upstream
12: revision pins.
13: 
14: ### Fixed stacks
15: - [ ] Replace `getcatch/drop` with **`Drop-OSS/drop`** in `bonneagar/stacks/drop/compose.yaml`
16: - [ ] Replace `nginx:alpine` static export with real **`storybookjs/storybook`** build pipeline in `bonneagar/stacks/storybook/compose.yaml` (serve via Nginx from a rebuilt `storybook-static/`)
17: - [ ] Regenerate `pangolin.yaml` for both stacks to align with the new upstreams
18: - [ ] Run `bun run validate-stacks` and confirm 2/2 changed pass
19: 
20: ### New GPU stacks (bunchloch M4 Max, sized 2 GB each)
21: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/sam3-server/` (6 files) — `facebook/sam3` on `http://sam3:9230/v1/segment`
22: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/sam3d-objects-server/` (6 files) — `facebook/sam-3d-objects` on `:9231`
23: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/trellis-server/` (6 files) — `microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B` on `:9232`
24: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/fibo-server/` (6 files) — BFL FIBO on `:9233`
25: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/comfyui/` (6 files, optional) — `ghcr.io/comfyanonymous/comfyui` on `:9234`
26: 
27: ### New headless / CPU stacks
28: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/libretro-retroarch/` (6 files) — headless `libretro/retroarch` cores on `:9240`
29: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/retroassembly/` (6 files) — `arianrhodsandlot/retroassembly` on `:9241`
30: - [ ] Create `bonneagar/stacks/pxlkit/` (6 files) — `joangeldelarosa/pxlkit` static export on `:9242`
31: 
32: ### Komodo + Pangolin + Infisical glue
33: - [ ] Add `bonneagar/komodo/procedures/{sam3-server,sam3d-objects-server,trellis-server,fibo-server,comfyui,libretro-retroarch,retroassembly,pxlkit}.toml`
34: - [ ] Add 6-label Pangolin private resources for each (route + auth + `pangolin.private-resources.<name>.{url,health,admin,ws,storage,cdn}`)
35: - [ ] Append the 8 new stacks + 2 fixes to `.infisical.env`; run `bun run scripts/init-vault.ts` to materialise the secrets in `dev-baile`
36: - [ ] `bun run validate-stacks` must remain 88/88 pass after additions
37: 
38: **Phase 0 gate:** `bun run validate-stacks` green; `bun run iac:bootstrap` no errors.
39: 
40: ---
41: 
42: ## Phase 1: SAM3 + SAM-3D-Objects segmentation in meaisinfhoghlaim (~1 day)
43: 
44: ### License + model card + version audit
45: - [ ] Verify Apache 2.0 (or compatible) licence for `facebook/sam3`
46: - [ ] Verify Apache 2.0 for `facebook/sam-3d-objects`
47: - [ ] Pin revisions in `bonneagar/stacks/sam3-server/compose.yaml` (commit SHA not `latest`)
48: - [ ] Same for `sam3d-objects-server`
49: 
50: ### Python wrapper
51: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/segmentation/__init__.py`
52: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/segmentation/openai_api.py`
53:   with the OpenAI-compatible request/response shapes
54: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/segmentation/sam3.py`
55:   with `class SAM3Client` and `segment(image, prompts) -> masks`
56: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/segmentation/sam3d_objects.py`
57:   with `class SAM3DObjectsClient` and
58:   `synthesize_3d(mask, image, format) -> glb_path | usdz_path`
59: - [ ] Add unit tests: mock the HTTP client, assert the request shape
60: 
61: ### BAML wrappers
62: - [ ] Extend `cianfhoghlaim/baml/retro/design_extraction.baml`
63:   with `function SegmentGameScreenshot(image: Image, prompt: str, ...) -> SegmentationMask`
64: - [ ] Same file: `function SpriteTo3D(sprite_mask, sprite_image, format) -> str`
65: - [ ] Run `baml-cli generate` to regenerate the BAML client
66: 
67: ### Health check + Langfuse wiring
68: - [ ] `curl https://sam3.cianfhoghlaim.ie/v1/health` returns 200
69: - [ ] Same for `sam3d.cianfhoghlaim.ie`
70: - [ ] Verify the requests land in Langfuse v3 as a trace (per
71:   `.agents/skills/agent-observability/SKILL.md`)
72: 
73: **Phase 1 gate:** Both SAM services are reachable from `bunchloch`;
74: `baml-cli generate` compiles clean; ≥1 unit test passes.
75: 
76: ---
77: 
78: ## Phase 2: Retro game-playing agents (~1 sprint)
79: 
80: ### libretro headless setup
81: - [ ] Pin the 6 libretro cores in `libretro-retroarch/compose.yaml`:
82:   `mesen` (NES), `snes9x` (SNES), `gambatte` (GB), `mgba` (GBA),
83:   `genesis_plus_gx` (Genesis), `pcsx_rearmed` (PS1)
84: - [ ] Wire the `ludusavi` volume mount so save states can be loaded
85:   via `ludusavi restore`
86: - [ ] Verify the 3 starting games (Number Munchers, Oregon Trail,
87:   Carmen Sandiego) are present in the ROMM library + Drop-OSS/drop
88: 
89: ### Python playback wrapper
90: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/__init__.py`
91: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/save_state.py`
92:   with `class LudusaviBridge` and `load_state(rom_sha, slot) -> state_path`
93: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/libretro.py`
94:   with `class LibretroClient` and
95:   `play_macro(rom, macro_buttons) -> List[PNG]` capturing one
96:   frame per major scene transition
97: - [ ] Add 3 macro scripts to `meaisinfoghlaim/playback/macros/`:
98:   - `number_munchers_title_to_level1.py`
99:   - `oregon_trail_title_to_choose_path.py`
100:   - `carmen_sandiego_title_to_evidence_board.py`
101: 
102: ### DLT source
103: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/__init__.py`
104: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/library.py` — yields `retro_library`
105:   resource from `romm` + `Drop-OSS/drop`
106: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/screenshots.py` — yields
107:   `retro_screenshots` resource, one row per `scene_id × frame_id`
108: - [ ] Add unit tests: mock libretro + ludusavi; assert ≥1 screenshot
109:   yields per game
110: 
111: ### Dagster sensor
112: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dagster/sensors/retro_library_watcher.py`
113:   with a `@sensor` that polls ROMM (`/api/roms`) + Drop-OSS
114:   (`/api/games`) every 30 min; on new entry materialises
115:   `retro_screenshots` for that game
116: 
117: **Phase 2 gate:** `retro_screenshots` produces ≥10 screenshots for
118: each of the 3 starting games; sensor fires on a synthetic new ROMM
119: event.
120: 
121: ---
122: 
123: ## Phase 3: Design-pattern extraction (~1 sprint)
124: 
125: ### BAML contracts
126: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/baml/retro/design_extraction.baml`
127: - [ ] Define the 4 classes per the proposal (UIPattern,
128:   SpriteArchetype, PedagogyPattern, GameDesignPattern)
129: - [ ] Define `class BilingualPatternText { text_en: str | null; text_ga: str | null }`
130: - [ ] Define `@function ExtractGameDesignPattern(image: Image, game_ctx: GameContext) -> GameDesignPattern`
131: - [ ] Use the `ExtractEnStrong` client by default + `ExtractGaStrong`
132:   fallback when `game_ctx.language == "ga"`
133: - [ ] Run `baml-cli generate`
134: 
135: ### CocoIndex v1 flow
136: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/cocoindex/retro_design_pattern_embedding.py`
137: - [ ] Reuse `from ._lifespan import LANCE_DB, EMBEDDER` (per
138:   REFACTORING.md item 12 enforcement)
139: - [ ] `@coco.App(refresh_interval=300)` walks
140:   `stedding/ingest_queue/retro/<platform>/<game>/<scene_id>.png`
141: - [ ] Yields `{id, game, platform, scene_id, text, embedding, subjects: list[str]}`
142: - [ ] Run the canonical 4-rule conformance linter via
143:   `cocoindex_v1_conformance_app`
144: 
145: ### DLT source
146: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/design_patterns.py` — yields
147:   `retro_design_patterns` resource, one row per
148:   `(game, level_index, scene_id)` with BAML-extracted
149:   `GameDesignPattern`
150: 
151: ### Dagster asset group
152: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dagster/assets/retro_design_patterns.py`
153: - [ ] 6 assets mirroring the per-subject template:
154:   `retro_screenshots_raw`, `retro_design_patterns_typed`,
155:   `retro_design_patterns_validation`, `retro_design_patterns_embedding`,
156:   `retro_design_patterns_validation_check`,
157:   `retro_design_patterns_dashboard_link`
158: 
159: **Phase 3 gate:** All 3 starting games produce ≥1 `GameDesignPattern`
160: per scene; the CocoIndex v1 table `oideachais.retro.design_patterns`
161: has ≥1 BGE-large-en-v1.5 vector per pattern; `mise run lint:skills`
162: remains green.
163: 
164: ---
165: 
166: ## Phase 4: Subject-conditioned asset generation (~2 sprints)
167: 
168: ### 2D pipeline (MMO v1)
169: - [ ] Add 8 BAML function signatures to
170:   `cianfhoghlaim/baml/retro/asset_prompt_generation.baml`
171:   (`GenerateChemistryAsset`, `GenerateGeographyAsset`,
172:   `GenerateMathematicsAsset`, `GenerateHistoryAsset`, … + 4 more)
173: - [ ] Each function takes `(syllabus_lo: LearningOutcome,
174:   design_pattern: GameDesignPattern, sprite_mask: SegmentationMask)`
175:   and returns an
176:   `AssetPrompt { negative_prompt: str, positive_prompt: str, model: "flux" | "z-image-turbo" | "qwen-image" | "fibo", seed: int }`
177: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/asset_caller.py`
178:   with `class AssetGenerationClient` that POSTs to the 4 image-gen
179:   services (Flux/Z-Image via InvokeAI; Qwen-Image via mlx-omni;
180:   FIBO via fibo-server)
181: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/asset_generation.py` — yields
182:   `asset_generation_2d` resource with rows keyed by
183:   `(subject, syllabus_lo, design_pattern_id)`
184: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dagster/assets/retro_asset_generation.py`
185:   — 6 assets mirroring the per-subject template
186: - [ ] Output: `stedding/asset_generation/2d/<subject>/<asset_id>.png`
187: 
188: ### 3D pipeline (MMO v2 staging)
189: - [ ] Add `function SynthesizeAsset3D(...)` to
190:   `cianfhoghlaim/baml/retro/asset_prompt_generation.baml`
191: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/asset_caller_3d.py`
192:   with `class AssetGenerationClient3D` that POSTs to
193:   `trellis-server` + `sam3d-objects-server`
194: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/dlt/retro/asset_generation_3d.py` —
195:   yields `asset_generation_3d` resource
196: - [ ] Output: `s3://cianfhoghlaim-asset-v2/3d/<subject>/<asset_id>.{glb,usdz}`
197: - [ ] Add a 90-day-lifecycle policy on the bucket (per the Risks section)
198: 
199: ### pxlkit + retroassembly integration
200: - [ ] Add `pixelpack(2d_dir) -> atlas.png` CLI call to
201:   `meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/asset_caller.py` (calls the `pxlkit`
202:   stack over HTTP)
203: - [ ] Add `retroassembly_import(metadata_jsonl) -> status: int` to
204:   the same module (calls the `retroassembly` stack)
205: 
206: ### Atlas delivery
207: - [ ] Create `stedding/asset_generation/2d/<subject>/atlas.png` per
208:   subject after every asset-generation materialisation
209: - [ ] Update `cianfhoghlaim/web/apps/cianfhoghlaim-mmo/src/lib/assets.ts`
210:   to point at the new atlas URLs
211: - [ ] Restart the MMO client stack to pick up the new assets
212: 
213: ### CocoIndex v1 flow for 2D + 3D
214: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/cocoindex/asset_generation_embedding.py`
215: - [ ] Indexes the `AssetPrompt` text + the asset file SHA-256 +
216:   subject tags
217: - [ ] Same pattern as `retro_design_pattern_embedding.py`
218: 
219: **Phase 4 gate:** Subject-conditioned generation produces ≥1 asset
220: per NCCA subject; the 2D output lands in the MMO client; the 3D
221: output lives in `s3://cianfhoghlaim-asset-v2/3d/`.
222: 
223: ---
224: 
225: ## Phase 5: Catalogue + delivery (~1 sprint)
226: 
227: ### Marimo dashboard
228: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/retro_game_design_catalogue.py`
229: - [ ] Imports the marimo pattern from
230:   `oideachais-marimo-dashboards/SKILL.md`
231: - [ ] Renders the design-pattern table + per-pattern sprite thumbnails
232:   + click-through to the asset generation
233: - [ ] Add a bilingual EN + GA toggle
234: 
235: ### Storybook variant
236: - [ ] Add a new workspace `packages/game-assets-storybook/` to the
237:   monorepo
238: - [ ] Workspace lists the design-pattern categories as sidebar nav
239: - [ ] Each category renders the pattern + at least 1 generated asset
240: - [ ] CI rebuilds the static export + the `storybook` stack serves it
241: 
242: ### pxlkit + retroassembly backends
243: - [ ] Wire `meaisinfhoghlaim/playback/asset_caller.py` to upload
244:   atlases + metadata to `retroassembly` after every materialisation
245: - [ ] Verify the retroassembly web UI shows the new atlas with
246:   correct tags (`subject=chemistry`, `design_pattern=...`)
247: 
248: ### Subject×design-pattern cross-walk
249: - [ ] Create `cianfhoghlaim/cocoindex/subject_design_xwalk.py`
250: - [ ] Generates a per-subject, per-NCCA-LO × design-pattern index
